title: Access declared a Party compromised (OP-149 m.7, m.17 (d), SI-9); the window runs from window_from to declared_at
description: The member of the SET `events` claim, and of the CloudEvent `data.events`, under `urn:suiss:access:event:party.compromised`.

instances.description: The Party's live Instances set up inside the window.

kids.description: RFC 7638 thumbprints of those Instances' keys, in the same order (CR-24).

occurred_at.description: When the compromise began, as declared; absent when unknown.

window_from.description: Window start, the value Access itself enforces: occurred_at, or the declaring Claim's issued_at minus 72 hours when occurred_at is unknown. Consumers use it as given and never compute it.

source.description: The Exercise whose decision recorded the event, or the Claim whose record admitted it.

access_position.description: The event's monotone version field (OP-22): it only grows within its source, the domain for an authority event and the issuer for an identity event. A receiver that has applied a later or equal position re-queries instead of applying this event.
